ov: صفقة مع امرأة هو فيلم غموض مصري من إخراج عادل الأعصر وبطولة مديحة كامل، حسين فهمي وعادل أدهم.
plotEn: Najwa, the wife of a rich man, attends therapy sessions with a psychiatrist named Sherif, who holds a forged doctorate from Essam, who in turn is using it to blackmail him. Essam and Najwa plot to kill her husband and frame Sherif. Sherif hears her confess in therapy to hiding her husband's body after killing him. Najwa falls in love with Sherif, to the consternation of the jealous Essam.
